function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• Rural interstate: 75 mph (or 70 mph if posted).
• Urban interstate: 65 mph.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat.
• Back‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited (unless hands‑free).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | TxDOT – Mobile Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal.
• Zero‑Tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs; yield at yield signs.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for merging, turning, and emergency vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Fog lights only on when visibility < 200 ft. | TxDOT – Lighting Requirements | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 15 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces, or on sidewalks. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children.
• Stop in both directions unless the bus is traveling on a one‑way street. | TxDOT – School Bus Safety | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals 100 ft before changing lanes.
• Overtake only when safe and legal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and inspected annually.
• Failure to register can result in fines and towing. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV – Insurance | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Trucks over 10,000 lb must have a commercial driver’s license (CDL).
• Bicycles must obey the same traffic laws as motor vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Regular updates on road safety and traffic regulations. - **TxDMV** – For registration, insurance, and licensing changes. - **Texas Legislature Online** – Access the Texas Transportation Code and recent amendments. ### Quick Tips 1. **Always check posted signs** – they can override general rules. 2. **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on a phone. 3. **Keep your vehicle’s registration and inspection stickers visible**. 4. **Know your local ordinances** – some cities have stricter speed limits or parking rules. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to comply with a particular regulation!
